algorithm: suffix log elementary-symmetric-polynomial DP plus sequential fixed-size sampling

truncation.bound_formula: exp(2 tau J pi^2 sum_{i=1}^m i^2) C^(m-1)/(m-1)! * sum_{k>K} exp(-8 tau J k^2), C=sum_{k>=1} exp(-8 tau J k^2), with both sums upper-bounded by first-term-plus-integral bounds

limitations: No quantum gate synthesis or physical hardware execution.
Timing covers Python DP and classical subset sampling only; the N-qubit sine/Givens state-preparation circuit is not included.
This is not an advantage claim; a classical computer can use the same mode subset sampler.
